contractCoverage.obligation: Closure receipts are attempt-scoped. Reacquisition atomically replaces only lease/fencing evidence; immutable commit-graph evidence cannot be regressed or replaced. Final output must name the fresh receipt that actually performs Git, not a released/expired refused receipt.
evidence: bun /tmp/g021-r3-red-team.ts :: the refused committed-not-pushed receipt became lockFencingValid=false after daemon shutdown and was never returned by recovery; per-run old and fresh IDs are retained in /tmp/g021-r3-red-team-results.json.

The healthy attempt replaced it with fresh lease/token 2 while lockFencingValid=true at after-push marker; marker response and final stored replay response used exactly that fresh receipt. After finalization the fresh lease was correctly released, showing the final response identifies the completed worker attempt rather than claiming ongoing validity.
The committed state and baseHead/baseTree/stagedTree/commitHead/committed/recoveryMarker evidence were byte-for-byte preserved across replaceExecutionLease; only attempt receipt fields changed.
